customers.why: One row per customer keyed by customerNumber with contact, address and credit limit; orders and payments point at it.

employees.why: One row per employee keyed by employeeNumber, pointing at offices; customers point at it and reportsTo is a self-reference.

offices.why: Seven offices keyed by officeCode with city, address and phone, columns that describe a place; employees point at it.

orderdetails.why: Lines of an order keyed by orderNumber and productCode with quantity and price; a line item, so an event whose time sits on orders.

orders.why: One row per order, stamped with orderDate; customerNumber repeats across orders.

payments.why: One row per cheque payment, stamped with paymentDate; customerNumber repeats across payments.

productlines.why: Seven product-line names with a text description (the HTML and image columns are empty), pointed at only by products.

products.why: One row per product keyed by productCode, pointing at productlines; orderdetails points at it.
